text:
karen: Morning dilemma: is semver an exact science or interpretive dance? :thinking_face:
diego: 100% interpretive dance. You need rhythm to bump minor versions. :ballet_shoes:
ci-bot: ci-bot: ⚠ Lint: found `version: 1.2` in config.yaml. Please use MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH.
harper: Saw someone try `version: 'v1.2.3.4'` yesterday. Felt like it was trying to summon a demon. :ghost:
ops-bot: ops-bot: Heads up: deploy blocked until version string is sane. See /runbooks/semver-etiquette.md.
sam: We should create a new wellness program: "Semver Yoga". Stretch, breathe, then fix your YAML.
karen: Workshop agenda: 1) breathing exercises for whitespace, 2) guided linting, 3) release notes limerick writing.
diego: Also a special track: "Compilers, but make it musical" where we sing linker errors as opera. I will be tenor.
ci-bot: ci-bot: Sample invalid entries found in repo: `version: 'one.two.three'`, `version: "v1..0"`, `version: 1.2`. Auto-suggested fix: normalize to `1.0.0` or ask author.
harper: tiny YAML horror show from this morning:
```yaml
service:
  name: payments
  version: "v1 . 0.0"
```
sam: That spacing is a cry for help. Leave a comforting GIF in the PR. :heart:
karen: Poll: do we require a comforting GIF on all YAML-changing PRs? react with :thumbsup: for yes, :thumbsdown: for no. ci-bot will tally.
diego: Also propose a sticker: "I survived the semver patch". Hand out at Semver Yoga.
ops-bot: ops-bot: Reminder: deploy windows today at 5pm. Bring your best normalized version numbers.
ci-bot: ci-bot: Poll ends in 45m. Current reaction tally will be posted.
